topic: How do GEO vs LEO satellite orbits affect latency and coverage in hybrid networks for rural substation monitoring?
consensus_response: GEO vs LEO satellite orbits significantly impact latency and coverage in hybrid networks. LEO orbits reduce latency but introduce Doppler effects and handover requirements, affecting network performance. GEO orbits provide global coverage but suffer from high latency, impacting real-time monitoring. Beamforming and adaptive modulation can mitigate these effects.
reference_context: Satellite communications face challenges like Doppler effects, latency, and coverage issues, affecting rural substation monitoring, with LEO and GEO orbits having different trade-offs.
